# Checkbox

<!-- Generated by scripts/sync-component-docs.mjs from ai/component-catalog.json and ai/component-composition.json. Do not edit; run `npm run catalog:sync`. -->

`@kerfjs/ui:checkbox` · Kerf UI · component · Controls

A native checkbox drawn as a Kerf box beside its label, with hint and error text on the label's column, a mixed (indeterminate) state, and native form participation.

## When to use

Turn one independent option on or off in a form or settings list, including a parent whose children are partly checked, without Web Awesome.

- A form or settings list has an independent yes/no option that is submitted or applied with the rest of the form.
- A parent option summarizes partly checked children: indeterminate, with wireCheckboxes(root).

**Not when:**

- Do not use for a setting that applies the moment it changes; use Switch.
- Do not use for one choice among several; use RadioGroup, ChoiceChips, or SegmentedControl.
- Do not use for several wrapping tag-like choices; use ChoiceChips multiple.

**Alternatives:**

- [Checkbox](./wa-checkbox.md) (prefer-over)
- [CheckboxGroup](./checkbox-group.md) (nearest) — Use CheckboxGroup for a labeled set of related options.
- [Switch](./switch.md) (nearest) — Use Switch for a setting that applies immediately.
- [ChoiceChips](./choice-chips.md) (nearest) — Use ChoiceChips multiple for several visible, wrapping choices.

## Imports

- JavaScript: `@kerfjs/ui/checkbox` — exports `Checkbox`, `wireCheckboxes`.
- CSS: the browser build of `@kerfjs/ui/checkbox` pulls its CSS automatically; import `@kerfjs/ui/checkbox.css` manually only without the `browser` export condition.
- Wiring: `wireCheckboxes` from `@kerfjs/ui/wire-checkboxes` (optional).
- Declared side effects: browser-condition-css.

## Props

Exact prop names and types: [`@kerfjs/ui/checkbox`](../public-api-signatures-v1.md#kerfjsuicheckbox) in `public-api-signatures-v1.md`. Do not infer props from examples.

**Variants (configure, do not restyle):**

- checked
- indeterminate
- hint

- required
- disabled
- default or compact size

## Composition

- Parents: any.
- Contexts: `application-ui`.
- Children: unrestricted.
- Built from: [LucideIcon](./lucide-icon.md).

## State and wiring

**The app owns:** checked and indeterminate state; validation and error copy; what a change does.

**Wiring:** `wireCheckboxes` is optional.

## Geometry

Margin: none · border: self · padding: none (layout role: controls). `self` means the component already owns it — do not add wrapper padding, margin, or borders around it.

- A 20px box (18px compact) 8px (7px) before its label; hint and error sit directly under the label, on its text column, like a grouped choice hint. Stack standalone Checkboxes in a List gap="xs" (8px), the same 28px pitch as RadioGroup choices.

## Accessibility

- A native \<input type="checkbox"> inside its \<label>, invisibly over the drawn box, so the label names it and pointer, keyboard, touch exploration, and forms reach the real control; Space toggles it and focus shows the focus ring on the box.
- The hint and error form the input's aria-description; an error sets aria-invalid="true" and the danger border. indeterminate sets the native indeterminate property through wireCheckboxes, so assistive technology reports a mixed state.

The component renders controls inside it, so it cannot sit in the zones of a component whose root is a control or link. (`KUI-V014`)

## Styling boundary

The component owns its own styles. Configure it through its props and variants; do not override its internals.

Public class hooks (select for layout placement only, never to change the component's look): `kui-checkbox`, `kui-checkbox__row`, `kui-checkbox__control`, `kui-checkbox__input`, `kui-checkbox__box`, `kui-checkbox__label`, `kui-checkbox__hint`, `kui-checkbox__error`.

Never put `kui-checkbox`, `kui-checkbox__row`, `kui-checkbox__control`, `kui-checkbox__input`, `kui-checkbox__box`, `kui-checkbox__label`, `kui-checkbox__hint`, `kui-checkbox__error` on an element you write; render `Checkbox` instead (`KUI-L103`).

Public tokens it reads: `--kui-color-brand-fill-loud`, `--kui-color-brand-on-loud`, `--kui-color-neutral-border-normal`, `--kui-color-surface`, `--kui-color-text`, `--kui-color-text-quiet`, `--kui-color-danger-border-loud`, `--kui-color-danger-on-quiet`, `--kui-focus-ring`, `--kui-font-m`, `--kui-font-s`, `--kui-font-xs`. Set a token only where its public contract allows; prefer a prop.

Everything else is internal: `kerf-ui-analyze` reports private or unknown `.kui-*` selectors (`KUI-L001`, `KUI-L010`), unknown or private tokens (`KUI-L002`, `KUI-L012`), and any application rule that restyles the component, forced dimensions included (`KUI-L019`).
